player_prompt.intro:
Yu em i Pleeya {player_id} long JoJoJoin, em i pley long borad 5x5 wantaim sel i numbared 0-24.
Long taim bilong yu, yu putim mark bilong yu long eni sel i wei, olsem '[12]'.
YU WIN bilong yu gat FOA bilong mark bilong yu i go daun — foa sel i go daun olsem wan lain, ap, o diagonali.
Olsem Pleeya {player_id} yu em i '{symbol}'; enemy bilong yu em i '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Dispela tok i no stret long pasin bilong raitim.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} em i no wanpela gutpela sel. Em mas stap namel long 0 na 24.

game_action.placed: Pleeya {player_id} putim mark bilong em ({symbol}) long sel {cell}.
